identified_tells_or_flaws: penjual.html uses completely different visual identity (orange #F97316 theme) vs index.html Machi sky/espresso aesthetic — zero design system continuity
Monolithic single-file architecture: ~1200+ lines of HTML+CSS+JS in index.html with no component separation
Menu catalog data hardcoded in JavaScript arrays, not fetched from API backend
Mobile navigation hidden behind md:flex with no hamburger menu fallback
Cart drawer, checkout modal, and order success modal all embedded inline in index.html
Multiple concurrent float animations on hero cups (4 independent keyframes) — exceeds single orchestrated motion moment limit
penjual.html lacks Google Fonts import (no Plus Jakarta Sans or Inter loaded)
penjual.html uses basic default Tailwind colors with no custom theme configuration
Footer giant wordmark 'kantin' at 15rem font-size may cause layout shift on mobile

existing_features.name: Hero Section with Floating SVG Cups
Full Menu Catalog with Warung Tabs
Order Success Modal with Live Status

recommendations_for_redesign: Extract shared design tokens (espresso, sky, pastel palette) into a persistent design-system.json for cross-page continuity
Redesign penjual.html to match Machi aesthetic: sky gradient header, Plus Jakarta Sans typography, pastel stat cards
Break monolithic index.html into component files (Hero, ProductCard, CartDrawer, OrderModal, Footer)
Consolidate hero cup animations to a single orchestrated reveal moment (Motion Cap Law: 1 per page)
Add mobile hamburger menu navigation for screens < md breakpoint
Move hardcoded warung catalog data to API endpoint or shared JSON module
Replace emoji-based product icons with consistent SVG illustration system
Implement gapless bento grid layout for menu catalog instead of uniform card grid
Add ARIA landmarks (role=main already present, but nav needs aria-label)
Reduce footer wordmark to responsive clamp(4rem, 10vw, 15rem) to prevent mobile overflow
